decisive_adjacency_independently_confirm.why_it_matters: This is the find that decisively refutes v2 - even the esoteric kodo monkoh incense game has a fresh-2026 AI classifier. Main agent independently re-searched and CONFIRMED it is a real paper, not a verifier hallucination.

hallucination_audit.readme_check_R13: The 4 new usable techniques carried into pairing were code-flagged by sourcing agents from explicit github/HF evidence (OmniVTA -> MrSecant/OmniVTA + OmniViTac dataset; Sound2Hap -> Iris1215/Sound2Hap + HF dataset; odor-strength -> peter-fichtelmann/odor-strength; kooplearn -> established PyPI/github library). SymTorch (astroautomata/SymTorch) was README-confirmed (HTTP 200) in session 2.
false_leads_caught_by_agents: LIFE/VERIFY caught 'Aqua Ignis A.I.' cognac = 'Artisanal Intelligence' (a steam-toasted-barrel marketing term), NOT machine learning - correctly excluded.
Multiple out-of-window date-traps rejected on ID prefix despite search-prose claiming 2026 (e.g. SmellNet/ScentFormer 2506.00239, Stochastic Neural DMD 2511.20612, Guiding-diffusion 2510.19971).
TECH-1 did not misattribute older unrelated github repos (greydanus/hamiltonian-nn 2019 etc.) to fresh papers - marked has_usable_code=false honestly.
hallucination_audit.note: No fabricated arXiv IDs, titles, or repos detected across 8 sourcing + 5 verification agents + 1 pairing subprocess.

logic_break_audit.finding: The params-v2 process fix WORKED and is measurable. In session 2 the adversarial verifiers produced 5 false-OPEN that the main-agent crosscheck had to overturn. In session 3 the SAME strict gate was baked INTO the verifier prompts ('any adjacency on either axis => NARROW; OPEN only for zero adjacency on both'). Result: the Phase-3 pairing proposer STILL showed optimism (7 of 12 preliminary-OPEN), but the Phase-4 verifiers returned 0 OPEN / 12 NARROW - the containment moved one stage earlier (proposer->verifier instead of verifier->crosscheck).
logic_break_audit.containment_result: 0 false WIN. Main-agent crosscheck independently confirmed the 12 NARROW verdicts and the single most-surprising adjacency (Genji 2602.02785). No verdict required overturning this session.
logic_break_audit.residual_proposer_optimism: The pairing proposer's 7 prelim-OPEN were all on no-analog crafts - it correctly identified the v2-plausible region but over-estimated emptiness, not yet internalising that a fresh technique-family ALWAYS has a sibling foothold. Acceptable: the proposer's job is to surface candidates; the gate's job is to grade them.

determinism.note: 8 sourcing + 5 verification agents + 1 opus pairing subprocess + main-agent crosscheck, all over live web search - result SETS not bit-reproducible. Robustness from 5 reformulations/candidate + independent main-agent re-verification of the load-bearing claims. The 12-NARROW outcome is highly stable: every candidate had >=1 cited adjacency on >=1 axis, most on both.

verbatim_caveat_R5_R6: WebFetch and direct arxiv.org returned HTTP 403 throughout (agent sandboxes and main agent). All verbatim_quote values are 'as seen in WebSearch result blocks', not hand-verified against live arXiv pages. The three main-agent crosscheck claims (Genji real, hedgelaying zero-AI, solera no-Koopman) were verified via WebSearch result text actually seen, recorded in crosscheck_s3.json with URLs. Agents recorded only what they saw; uncertain items marked false/excluded.
